description: AGSC-09-17 (a): the manifest is written only when `--manifest` is given, so the files of an export are those of 1.0 otherwise (`export-0001`, `export-0002`), and it is a pure function of the build. Same fixture as `export-0003`, exported with `--jsonl`. `with-manifest`: the export writes `items.jsonl` and `export-manifest.json`, the manifest lists `items.jsonl` and nothing else (never itself), with the digest of that file's bytes, which are the lines of `export-0002`; the same run repeated writes the same manifest bytes (`repeat_identical`). `without-manifest`: the export writes `items.jsonl` alone. The limits on the header fields of AGSC-09-17 (b) are served-file rules, proved by the `build` cases of the headers and not here.
